methodology.known_input: Exact local tokenization of current instructions, serialized USER, canonical output schema; actual provider rendering remains calibrated
methodology.input_proxy: known input sum + per-request mean pilot residual for the SAME stage/model
methodology.outputs: Per-document sum of old chunk outputs; mean/median/p90 proxies stratified by source kind and supplied body-token bucket (pilot: sum of original chunks; plan: selected bounded passages), min5 support then length/stage fallback; capped by the request output limit
methodology.p90_warning: Sum of per-document p90 proxies is not a p90 total or confidence bound
methodology.pass_assumption: 50%, old observed-positive doc fraction, and100%; common fraction applied uniformly to planned extraction costs, not actual new classifications
methodology.extract_context: Local candidate IDs plus one representative pilot relevance metadata template, only for token-cost construction; not a model answer
methodology.describe: Conditional eligible fact yield transferred by sourcekind/length; ceil(expectedfacts/60), calibrated fixed/group+data/fact; only two pilot descriptor calls may exist
methodology.cache: Standard uncached rates, no guaranteed future cache saving
methodology.representativeness: Pilot259-record three-day/topic composition is not representative of the full source; sparse strata and longer/adaptive contexts can change outputs and fact yield
methodology.scope: One relevance/extraction/descriptor pass only; final scoring, human audit, synthesis, reruns and retries excluded

limitations: Local cleaning is not final semantic relevance classification.
Name and language hints do not establish identity or language; unknowns remain reviewable.
Near-duplicate candidate components are not proven equivalent stories or independent episodes.
Output counts, relevance and descriptor yield are forecasts from the earlier pilot, not measured on this file.
Final politician scores, interpretation and report generation are outside this API estimate.
